title: Wisdom Unfolding and the Five Foundational Sayings
description: T11 is a litany tracing every good operation in the soul back to the Lord at his proper register: every gift to the Father of Greatness, every blessing and prayer to the life-bearing principle, every counsel to ruling truth, every honor to the celestial love returned, every act of contention to the Divine Human, every life to the Father of Life, every structure to divine order, every loosening to truth spoken into the rational, every wisdom to pure receivability, every awakening to the Lord ordering the inner mind. T12 grounds the rational in five foundational sayings — confessional namings of the Lord that establish the law of the living, by which what is good and what is bitter are distinguished, all of which are the one Lord whose names these five doctrines are.
